Structurally cataloged as a leaf section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text applies conditional relations (*paccaya*) to the dyadic category (*duka*) of phenomena that are not themselves roots or causal conditions (*nahetu*) but are accompanied by roots (*sahetuka*) [SuttaCentral].
